unmodelled.source_quote: Must be a resident of West Bengal

unmodelled.text: Must work, or be likely to work, outside West Bengal (other states or abroad)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be employed or likely to be employed outside West Bengal (in other states/UTs or abroad).

en.title: West Bengal Migrant Worker Welfare Scheme
en.benefit: Rs 50,000 on natural death, Rs 2 lakh on accidental death, Rs 25,000 to bring the body home, and Rs 50,000 to Rs 1 lakh for disability.
en.how_to_apply: Register on the Karmasathi Parijayee Shramik Portal with your mobile number to get an MWIN, then file claims there.
